items.q: Django had an approach to the guitar unlike any other guitarist playing in the States. He had a phenomenal execution...

ctx.x: I was astonished because I had never heard a guitarist play the way he played, and I was even more surprised that a foreigner could play such wonderful jazz. Grapelli was also very good. I had heard Joe Venuti when I was an amateur musician. Later, when I became a professional, I had heard Robert "Juice" Wilson playing in Buffalo. We used to go to the place where he worked every night after we had finished our job at the Ballroom. But Grapelli was really a surprise, because no-one had ever mentioned him to me. In…

Django had an approach to the guitar unlike any other guitarist playing in the States. He had a phenomenal execution, and he was taking a lot of solos at a time when solos were not known about on the guitar as a rule. Teddy Bunn, for instance, didn't have Django's speed or technical mastery. In fact the quintet as a whole, liked to play numbers fast. However, Djano was also an excellent accompanist. He seemed to have ideas which would stray a little from the original harmonies, so there was always something which…

About two weeks after we had been in the Villa d'Este, I was asked if I would accept a job to sing in a club called "l'Heure Bleue" on rue Fromentin, after I had finished my night at the Villa d'Este. I had never done much singing except for a few group vocals with Lloyds Scott, but I knew the words to many songs and my voice was not the worst that could be hears so I thought it would be kicks to do a little singing and I accepted the proposition.
